summary.text: Eldest daughter of Anchises, whom her father and queenly mother heartily loved for comeliness, handiwork, and wisdom — given in marriage to Alcathous, dear son of Aesyetes and fosterling of Aeneas.

story.text: Homer names Hippodameia eldest of Anchises' daughters when Alcathous, son by marriage to Anchises, falls before Idomeneus. She excelled all maidens of her years in comeliness, handiwork, and wisdom; wherefore the best man in wide Troy had taken her to wife.
